$comment: Static Astro build. The build command runs sync:upstream FIRST because the SDK reference (src/content/docs/docs/sdk/) is generated by starlight-typedoc from the .upstream/ checkout and is gitignored — without the sync step Vercel would publish the site with /docs/sdk/ missing. Everything else derived from warren (narrative docs, CLI reference, facts.generated.json) IS committed, so the sync step is idempotent for those and only fails the build on genuine upstream drift.
buildCommand: bun run sync:upstream && bun run build
